core: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation
qualifier: positive regulation with NK/T cell transcript signatures
name: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All members concern activation of NK or T cell cytotoxic effector function or NK/T cell signatures, and the theme is restricted to positive regulation while confusables add inhibitory receptors, KIR, granzyme killing and MHC class Ib presentation.

qualifier: with ATR replication stress checkpoint
name: Replication origin licensing and replication stress checkpoint
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and its control plus ATR-mediated replication checkpoint signaling, whereas confusables are dominated by E2F transcription and generic replication initiation.

qualifier: lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited enzyme or transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoids and inherited fatty acid enzyme defects
rationale: Members share fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism via the 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin route and inherited defects of fatty acid enzymes and transporters, unlike confusables centred on P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase routes.

qualifier: glucocorticoid secretion and signaling
name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress axis and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members cover CRH/ACTH-driven cortisol and corticosterone secretion, glucocorticoid responses and stress behavior, distinguishing it from confusables about innate behaviors, sleep/feeding neuropeptides and growth hormone/prolactin.

qualifier: endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING with herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signaling, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-beta, including TLR3-pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis, whereas confusables emphasize RIG-I/IRF3, ADAR editing and IRF7 induction.

core: Stress responses and innate motivated behaviors
qualifier: mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behavior
name: Stress responses and innate motivated behaviors
rationale: Members combine corticosterone/CRH stress and fear responses with instinctive social and consummatory behaviors, unlike confusables centred on HPA hormone secretion, sleep neuropeptides or drug-reward learning.

qualifier: chaperonin TRiC/CCT folding and aggregate clearance
name: Chaperone folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span chaperone and TRiC/CCT-mediated folding, refolding, protein stabilization and clearance of misfolded proteins by aggrephagy, CMA and proteasome regulation, while confusables lack the chaperonin folding arm and focus on ubiquitin chain biology or ribosome quality control.

qualifier: glycogenolysis and alanine-linked gluconeogenesis
name: Glucose catabolism, glycogenolysis and alanine gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, hexose phosphate metabolism, glycogen breakdown, gluconeogenesis and alanine metabolism, distinguishing them from confusables on glycogen storage disease, fructose and glycerol metabolism.

qualifier: regulation of import and export
name: Regulation of nuclear protein import and export
rationale: All three members regulate protein import into or export from the nucleus, while confusables concern nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and specific cargo export.

qualifier: CaMK-CREB signaling and local synaptic translation
name: CaMK-CREB and synaptic translation in plasticity and memory
rationale: Members share activity-dependent synaptic plasticity and memory driven by CaMK-mediated CREB/NPAS4 transcription and synaptic translational control, unlike confusables built on cAMP/adenylate cyclase or AMPK signaling.

qualifier: choline, carnitine and S-adenosylmethionine
name: Choline, carnitine and S-adenosylmethionine methyl-donor metabolism
rationale: Members concern choline catabolism, carnitine synthesis and SAM metabolism with its inherited defects, distinguishing it from confusables on methionine salvage, phospholipid/FMO metabolism or acyl-CoA catabolism.

qualifier: flavonoid and glycoside handling
name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with flavonoid glycosides
rationale: Members share xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation including sulfonation, and the theme uniquely carries flavone metabolism and glycoside transport absent from confusables focused on toxins, CYP reactions or drug ADME.

qualifier: CDC42 signaling and restraint of integrin adhesion
name: CDC42 leading-edge protrusion and restraint of integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern CDC42/IQGAP-driven leading-edge actin dynamics together with negative regulation of integrin adhesion, Rac/Rho signaling and lamellipodia, which confusables lack in favour of epithelial migration, wound healing or WASP/WAVE activation.

qualifier: oxysterol routes and hereditary spastic paraplegias
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis via 24- and 27-hydroxycholesterol and diseases of oxysterol and related enzymes (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42), unlike confusables on the 7alpha route, peroxisomal oxidation or cholesterol biosynthesis.

qualifier: mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
name: Organelle-selective autophagy, mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
rationale: Members span autophagosome formation and lysosomal fusion for mitochondria, peroxisomes, ER and nucleus, with a mitochondrial arm (PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, fission/fusion, protein targeting) that confusables lack.

qualifier: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA and siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-directed translational repression or mRNA destabilization, while confusables focus on specific miRNA targets, miRNA decay or deadenylation.

qualifier: sodium-calcium exchange and cytosolic calcium removal
name: Cardiomyocyte calcium homeostasis via sodium-calcium exchange
rationale: Members concern cytosolic calcium handling and ion homeostasis in cardiac muscle including Na/Ca exchange and calcium sequestration, distinguishing them from confusables on SR pumps, ryanodine release or relaxation.

qualifier: complexes III and IV with inner membrane insertion
name: Respiratory complex III/IV assembly and inner membrane insertion
rationale: Members cover assembly of complexes III and IV and respirasomes plus protein insertion into the mitochondrial inner membrane, unlike confusables on complex I, ATP synthase, iron-sulfur clusters or electron transport itself.

qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK/p38 signaling
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 signaling
rationale: Members concern NOD1/2 and inflammasome sensing of peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide with K63 ubiquitination and TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 regulation, while confusables center on TLR/TRIF-driven IKK and NF-kappaB.

qualifier: phosphatidylinositol and sterol transfer at contact sites
name: ER phosphatidylinositol and sterol transfer between membranes
rationale: Members share ER-based lipid transfer and membrane tethering, including PI synthesis, PI/PC and cholesterol transport, distinguishing them from confusables on ER tubule shaping, glycolipid transfer or phosphoinositide phosphorylation.

qualifier: mycotoxin and aflatoxin detoxification
name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with aflatoxin detoxification
rationale: Members share xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation with sulfonation, and the theme uniquely carries mycotoxin, polyketide and aflatoxin detoxification absent from the flavonoid or CYP/drug-conjugation confusables.

qualifier: ABC transporters and their cholestasis defects
name: ABC transporter-mediated bile acid and xenobiotic efflux
rationale: Members concern transmembrane export of xenobiotics and bile acids, including ABCB11/ABCB4 cholestasis defects and blood-brain barrier transport, unlike confusables on bile acid synthesis, SLCO/UGT organic anion handling or lipid flippases.

qualifier: ATM sensing and classical NHEJ
name: Double-strand break sensing, ATM signaling and classical NHEJ
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM-mediated recruitment and classical non-homologous end joining, whereas confusables emphasize end resection, homologous recombination, alt-NHEJ and SSA.

qualifier: DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation
name: Histone and DNA methylation, imprinting and heterochromatin silencing
rationale: Members concern histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, DNA methylation, PRC2 and CHD/NuRD remodelers acting in imprinting, X inactivation and heterochromatin, which confusables lack in favour of nucleosome assembly, BAF complexes or deacetylation.

qualifier: E2F-driven proliferation signatures and G1/S entry
name: E2F-driven DNA replication and G1/S cell-cycle signatures
rationale: Members share mitotic-cycle DNA replication initiation and its control with E2F and cell-cycle transcript modules and G1/S promotion, distinguishing them from confusables on pre-RC licensing/ATR checkpoint or DNA repair replication.
